name: Pudding Mob
body:
School conjuration (summoning); Level sorcerer/wizard 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, M (a small mixture of flour and egg)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect 1d4+1 behemoth puddings
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell summons a 1d4+1 behemoth puddings. They appears where you designate and act immediately, on your turn. They attack your opponents to the best of their ability. If you can communicate with the creatures, you can direct them not to attack, to attack particular enemies, or to perform other actions.
